title: Daily digest: Level 3 Elevated
message: Two tankers were hit by projectiles off Oman near Hormuz on Saturday (UK maritime agency); no injuries. No new attacks on US bases; oil eased to about US$90. Elsewhere: the FBI is checking a suspected hack of a US crime database; no effect on us. To do: tidy dry grass near the house. Hills fire danger High today and Monday, gusty winds.
